description: Cutaway blueprint view of a 4-stroke single-cylinder engine built from general primitives. The crankshaft spins continuously (rps=0.35), driving the connecting rod and piston via solveCrankSlider, while intake and exhaust valves open/close in sync with the 0..720 degree cycle.

hud.text: Satu siklus 4 tak terdiri dari hisap, kompresi, usaha, dan buang.

description: First half of the 4-stroke cycle: crankAngle goes smoothly from 0 to 2*PI (0° to 360°). From 0-3s (0°-180°, Hisap), intake valve (left, cyan) drops open (-0.22) as piston moves down and cyan fuel-air mist fills the chamber. From 3-6s (180°-360°, Kompresi), both valves close and piston rises to compress the mixture.

hud.title: KATUP HISAP
hud.body: Terbuka saat piston turun (0°–180°) lalu menutup rapat.

hud.text: Hisap memasukkan campuran udara-bahan bakar, lalu kompresi memadatkannya.

description: Second half of the 4-stroke cycle: crankAngle goes smoothly from 2*PI to 4*PI (360° to 720°). At 0-0.8s (near 360°), the spark plug fires a bright yellow Sphere flash, pushing the piston down during Usaha (0-3.5s, 360°-540°, both valves closed). From 3.5-7s (540°-720°, Buang), the exhaust valve (right, coral) drops open (-0.22) as piston rises to push exhaust out.

hud.title: BUSI & KATUP BUANG
hud.body: Percikan busi memicu langkah usaha; katup buang membuka di 540°–720°.

hud.text: Ledakan pembakaran mendorong piston ke bawah, lalu gas sisa dibuang.

description: Full 4-stroke cycle (0° to 720° over 6s, rps = 1/3) with complete valve timing (intake open 0-180°, spark near 360°, exhaust open 540-720°). Show StatCounter counting up engine speed from 1.000 to 6.000 RPM (using id-ID number formatting) and a Callout highlighting the crank-rod linkage.

hud.title: ENGKOL-BATANG
hud.body: Mengubah gerak naik-turun piston menjadi putaran poros.

hud.text: Siklus 4 tak berulang ribuan kali per menit untuk menghasilkan tenaga.
